# 1. Analysis object and negative controls

This report uses the complete pre-decontamination dataset used for the submitted
supplementary contamination analysis: 50 skin samples and five parallel air-swab
negative controls. The Copan-forehead tutorial subset is not used here.

```{r libraries-and-data}
library(phyloseq)
library(decontam)
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(ggh4x)
library(RColorBrewer)

source(file.path(project_root, "analysis", "final", "R", "functions.R"))

phy3 <- readRDS(file.path(project_root, "data", "process", "phyloseq_predecontam.rds"))

# The archived pre-decontamination RDS predates the final rank-name cleanup.
# Reattach the finalized 2,108-ASV taxonomy used to produce the submitted figures.
taxonomy_reference <- read.delim(
  file.path(project_root, "data", "process", "predecontam_taxonomy_table.tsv"),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
taxonomy_match <- match(taxa_names(phy3), taxonomy_reference$ASV)
stopifnot(!anyNA(taxonomy_match))
taxonomy_reference <- taxonomy_reference[
  taxonomy_match,
  c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
]
rownames(taxonomy_reference) <- taxa_names(phy3)
tax_table(phy3) <- tax_table(as.matrix(taxonomy_reference))

sample_data(phy3)$control_status <- ifelse(
  sample_data(phy3)$site_group == "negative-control",
  "control",
  "sample"
)
sample_data(phy3)$is.neg <- sample_data(phy3)$control_status == "control"

sample_counts <- table(sample_data(phy3)$control_status)
stopifnot(
  ntaxa(phy3) == 2108,
  nsamples(phy3) == 55,
  unname(sample_counts["sample"]) == 50,
  unname(sample_counts["control"]) == 5
)

data.frame(
  Dataset = "Pre-decontamination phyloseq object",
  ASVs = ntaxa(phy3),
  Skin_samples = unname(sample_counts["sample"]),
  Negative_controls = unname(sample_counts["control"]),
  Total_reads = sum(sample_sums(phy3))
) |> kable()
```

# 2. Prevalence-based decontam analysis

The prevalence method is evaluated at thresholds 0.1 through 0.9. The submitted
analysis selected threshold 0.5.

```{r asv-summary}
summarize_asv_by_group <- function(ps, group_var = "is.neg") {
  ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) if (sum(x) == 0) x else x / sum(x))
  otu <- as(otu_table(ps_rel), "matrix")
  if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_rel)) otu <- t(otu)
  meta <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps_rel))

  true_samples <- rownames(meta)[!meta[[group_var]]]
  control_samples <- rownames(meta)[meta[[group_var]]]
  otu_true <- otu[, true_samples, drop = FALSE]
  otu_control <- otu[, control_samples, drop = FALSE]

  tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
    rownames_to_column("ASV")

  summary_df <- tibble(
    ASV = rownames(otu),
    Abundance.TrueSample = rowMeans(otu_true),
    Abundance.Control = rowMeans(otu_control),
    Prevalence.TrueSample = rowSums(otu_true > 0),
    Prevalence.Control = rowSums(otu_control > 0),
    PrevalencePercent.TrueSample = 100 * rowSums(otu_true > 0) / length(true_samples),
    PrevalencePercent.Control = 100 * rowSums(otu_control > 0) / length(control_samples)
  )

  left_join(tax_df, summary_df, by = "ASV")
}

asv_summary <- summarize_asv_by_group(phy3)
thresholds <- seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1)
permanova_results <- data.frame()
mlt_all <- psmelt(phy3)

for (th in thresholds) {
  contamdf_th <- isContaminant(
    phy3,
    method = "prevalence",
    neg = "is.neg",
    threshold = th
  )
  contaminant_asvs <- rownames(contamdf_th)[contamdf_th$contaminant]
  column_name <- paste0("contam_th", gsub("\\.", "", format(th, nsmall = 1)))
  asv_summary[[column_name]] <- asv_summary$ASV %in% contaminant_asvs

  phy_clean <- prune_taxa(!contamdf_th$contaminant, phy3)
  phy_skin_all <- subset_samples(phy3, is.neg == FALSE)
  phy_control_all <- subset_samples(phy3, is.neg == TRUE)
  phy_skin <- subset_samples(phy_clean, is.neg == FALSE)
  phy_control <- subset_samples(phy_clean, is.neg == TRUE)

  otu_mat <- as(otu_table(phy_clean), "matrix")
  if (taxa_are_rows(phy_clean)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
  meta <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_clean), check.names = FALSE)
  distance_bc <- vegdist(otu_mat, method = "bray")
  set.seed(123)
  perm <- adonis2(distance_bc ~ is.neg, data = meta, permutations = 9999)

  permanova_results <- bind_rows(permanova_results, data.frame(
    threshold = th,
    n_contam_ASV = length(contaminant_asvs),
    contam_relab_pct = round(100 * sum(mlt_all$Abundance[mlt_all$OTU %in% contaminant_asvs]) /
                                sum(mlt_all$Abundance), 3),
    reads_retained_total = round(100 * sum(otu_table(phy_clean)) / sum(otu_table(phy3)), 3),
    reads_retained_skin = round(100 * sum(otu_table(phy_skin)) / sum(otu_table(phy_skin_all)), 3),
    reads_retained_ctrl = round(100 * sum(otu_table(phy_control)) / sum(otu_table(phy_control_all)), 3),
    asv_retained_total_pct = round(100 * ntaxa(phy_clean) / ntaxa(phy3), 3),
    asv_retained_skin_pct = round(100 * sum(taxa_sums(phy_skin) > 0) /
                                    sum(taxa_sums(phy_skin_all) > 0), 3),
    asv_retained_ctrl_pct = round(100 * sum(taxa_sums(phy_control) > 0) /
                                    sum(taxa_sums(phy_control_all) > 0), 3),
    R2_is_control = round(perm$R2[1], 4),
    p_is_control = perm$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  ))
}

write.csv(
  permanova_results,
  file.path(project_root, "result", "final", "tables", "Contamination_threshold_sensitivity.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

permanova_results |> kable(digits = 3)
```

## 2.1 Reconciliation with the submitted results

```{r submitted-reconciliation}
selected <- permanova_results |> filter(threshold == 0.5)
stopifnot(
  selected$n_contam_ASV == 107,
  round(selected$reads_retained_skin, 1) == 91.6,
  round(selected$asv_retained_skin_pct, 1) == 94.8,
  round(selected$reads_retained_ctrl, 1) == 24.3
)

tibble(
  Quantity = c(
    "ASVs classified as contaminants",
    "Skin-sample reads retained (%)",
    "Skin-sample ASVs retained (%)",
    "Negative-control reads remaining (%)"
  ),
  Submitted = c(107, 91.6, 94.8, 24.3),
  Regenerated = c(
    selected$n_contam_ASV,
    round(selected$reads_retained_skin, 1),
    round(selected$asv_retained_skin_pct, 1),
    round(selected$reads_retained_ctrl, 1)
  )
) |> kable()
```

# 3. Supplementary Figure S1

```{r figure-s1, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
reads_long <- permanova_results |>
  select(
    threshold,
    Total = reads_retained_total,
    Skin = reads_retained_skin,
    Control = reads_retained_ctrl
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-threshold, names_to = "sample_type", values_to = "value")

asv_long <- permanova_results |>
  select(
    threshold,
    Total = asv_retained_total_pct,
    Skin = asv_retained_skin_pct,
    Control = asv_retained_ctrl_pct
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-threshold, names_to = "sample_type", values_to = "value")

type_colors <- c(Total = "black", Skin = "steelblue", Control = "tomato")

p_reads <- ggplot(reads_long, aes(threshold, value, color = sample_type, shape = sample_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = type_colors, name = "Sample type") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Total = 16, Skin = 17, Control = 15), name = "Sample type") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = thresholds) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  labs(x = "Threshold", y = "Reads retained (%)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p_asvs <- ggplot(asv_long, aes(threshold, value, color = sample_type, shape = sample_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = type_colors, name = "Sample type") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Total = 16, Skin = 17, Control = 15), name = "Sample type") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = thresholds) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  labs(x = "Threshold", y = "ASVs retained (%)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

contamdf01 <- isContaminant(phy3, method = "prevalence", neg = "is.neg", threshold = 0.1)
p_pval <- ggplot(contamdf01, aes(p)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "grey30", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = thresholds, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "p-value (contaminant probability)", y = "Count") +
  theme_bw()

phy_pa <- transform_sample_counts(phy3, function(x) 1 * (x > 0))
phy_pa_control <- subset_samples(phy_pa, is.neg == TRUE)
phy_pa_skin <- subset_samples(phy_pa, is.neg == FALSE)
prevalence_df <- data.frame(
  pa.pos = taxa_sums(phy_pa_skin),
  pa.neg = taxa_sums(phy_pa_control),
  contaminant = asv_summary$contam_th05
)
p_prevalence <- ggplot(prevalence_df, aes(pa.neg, pa.pos, color = contaminant)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Prevalence (Negative Controls)", y = "Prevalence (True Samples)")

removed_genera <- asv_summary |>
  filter(contam_th05) |>
  count(Genus) |>
  arrange(desc(n))
p_genus <- ggplot(removed_genera, aes(reorder(Genus, n), n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey30") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Genus", y = "Number of ASVs") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))

figure_s1 <- ((p_reads | p_asvs | p_pval) / (p_prevalence | p_genus)) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.7, 1.1), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

figure_s1

ggsave(
  file.path(project_root, "result", "final", "figures", "FigureS1.png"),
  figure_s1,
  width = 12,
  height = 10
)
```

# 4. Supplementary Figure S2

```{r figure-s2, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
composition_plot <- function(ps) {
  ps_nonzero <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps) > 0, ps)
  ps_genus <- tax_glom(ps_nonzero, "Genus")
  ps_genus_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_genus, function(x) x / sum(x))
  selected_taxa <- filter_taxa(ps_genus_rel, function(x) mean(x) > 0.01, TRUE)

  plotted <- taxa_plot(
    melt = psmelt(ps_genus),
    taxa = "Genus",
    tax_otu = taxa_names(selected_taxa),
    x_axis = "Sample",
    phylum_or = "Actinobacteriota"
  )

  ggplot(plotted$data$df, aes(Sample, Abundance, fill = Genus)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    labs(y = "Read Count") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_blank()
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = plotted$color) +
    facet_grid(~control_status, scales = "free_x") +
    ggh4x::force_panelsizes(cols = c(0.6, 1.4))
}

phy3_noncontam <- prune_taxa(!asv_summary$contam_th05, phy3)
plot_before <- composition_plot(phy3)
plot_after <- composition_plot(phy3_noncontam)
figure_s2 <- plot_before / plot_after +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

figure_s2

ggsave(
  file.path(project_root, "result", "final", "figures", "FigureS2.png"),
  figure_s2,
  width = 12,
  height = 8
)
```

# 5. Residual negative-control reads at threshold 0.5

This table describes the 24.3% of negative-control reads remaining after the
submitted threshold was applied. The overlap indicator is limited to the dominant
genera reported in the skin-sample composition results.

```{r residual-negative-control-profile}
control_ids <- sample_names(subset_samples(phy3, is.neg == TRUE))
retained_asvs <- asv_summary$ASV[!asv_summary$contam_th05]
phy_control_retained <- prune_samples(
  control_ids,
  prune_taxa(retained_asvs, phy3)
)

control_matrix <- as(otu_table(phy_control_retained), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_control_retained)) control_matrix <- t(control_matrix)
control_taxonomy <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_control_retained), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  rownames_to_column("ASV")

residual_control_genera <- tibble(
  ASV = rownames(control_matrix),
  Reads = rowSums(control_matrix)
) |>
  left_join(control_taxonomy, by = "ASV") |>
  mutate(Genus = if_else(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unclassified", Genus)) |>
  group_by(Genus) |>
  summarise(Reads = sum(Reads), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    Percent_of_residual_control_reads = 100 * Reads / sum(Reads),
    Overlaps_reported_dominant_skin_genera = Genus %in%
      c("Cutibacterium", "Staphylococcus", "Corynebacterium", "Streptococcus")
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(Reads))

original_control_reads <- sum(sample_sums(phy3)[control_ids])
residual_control_reads <- sum(residual_control_genera$Reads)
stopifnot(round(100 * residual_control_reads / original_control_reads, 1) == 24.3)

write.csv(
  residual_control_genera,
  file.path(
    project_root,
    "result",
    "final",
    "tables",
    "Reviewer1_residual_negative_control_genera.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

residual_control_genera |>
  filter(Reads > 0) |>
  head(20) |>
  kable(digits = c(NA, 0, 2, NA))
```

## 5.1 ASV-level decontam results and exact skin-sample overlap

Because decontam classifies features at the ASV level, the files generated below
retain individual ASV identities. An ASV is classified as shared only when the
same ASV identifier has at least one read in both the negative controls and the
skin samples. Genus-level co-occurrence alone is not counted as exact overlap.

```{r residual-negative-control-asv-audit}
contamdf05 <- isContaminant(
  phy3,
  method = "prevalence",
  neg = "is.neg",
  threshold = 0.5
)

count_matrix <- as(otu_table(phy3), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(phy3)) count_matrix <- t(count_matrix)

skin_ids <- sample_names(subset_samples(phy3, is.neg == FALSE))
control_ids <- sample_names(subset_samples(phy3, is.neg == TRUE))
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy3), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  rownames_to_column("ASV")

decontam_df <- as.data.frame(contamdf05, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  rownames_to_column("ASV") |>
  rename(
    Decontam_frequency = freq,
    Decontam_prevalence = prev,
    Decontam_p_frequency = p.freq,
    Decontam_p_prevalence = p.prev,
    Decontam_p_combined = p,
    Contaminant_at_threshold_0_5 = contaminant
  )

sample_relative_abundance <- sweep(
  count_matrix,
  2,
  colSums(count_matrix),
  "/"
)

all_asv_results <- tibble(
  ASV = rownames(count_matrix),
  ASV_input_order = seq_len(nrow(count_matrix)),
  NC_reads_raw = rowSums(count_matrix[, control_ids, drop = FALSE]),
  NC_prevalence_n = rowSums(count_matrix[, control_ids, drop = FALSE] > 0),
  NC_total_samples = length(control_ids),
  NC_prevalence_pct = 100 * NC_prevalence_n / NC_total_samples,
  NC_mean_relative_abundance_pct =
    100 * rowMeans(sample_relative_abundance[, control_ids, drop = FALSE]),
  Skin_reads_raw = rowSums(count_matrix[, skin_ids, drop = FALSE]),
  Skin_prevalence_n = rowSums(count_matrix[, skin_ids, drop = FALSE] > 0),
  Skin_total_samples = length(skin_ids),
  Skin_prevalence_pct = 100 * Skin_prevalence_n / Skin_total_samples,
  Skin_mean_relative_abundance_pct =
    100 * rowMeans(sample_relative_abundance[, skin_ids, drop = FALSE])
) |>
  left_join(tax_df, by = "ASV") |>
  left_join(decontam_df, by = "ASV") |>
  mutate(
    Retained_at_threshold_0_5 = !Contaminant_at_threshold_0_5,
    Exact_ASV_shared_NC_and_skin = NC_prevalence_n > 0 & Skin_prevalence_n > 0,
    Residual_in_NC_after_filtering =
      Retained_at_threshold_0_5 & NC_prevalence_n > 0
  ) |>
  select(
    ASV,
    ASV_input_order,
    Kingdom,
    Phylum,
    Class,
    Order,
    Family,
    Genus,
    Species,
    Decontam_frequency,
    Decontam_prevalence,
    Decontam_p_frequency,
    Decontam_p_prevalence,
    Decontam_p_combined,
    Contaminant_at_threshold_0_5,
    Retained_at_threshold_0_5,
    NC_reads_raw,
    NC_prevalence_n,
    NC_total_samples,
    NC_prevalence_pct,
    NC_mean_relative_abundance_pct,
    Skin_reads_raw,
    Skin_prevalence_n,
    Skin_total_samples,
    Skin_prevalence_pct,
    Skin_mean_relative_abundance_pct,
    Exact_ASV_shared_NC_and_skin,
    Residual_in_NC_after_filtering
  )

residual_asv_results <- all_asv_results |>
  filter(Residual_in_NC_after_filtering) |>
  mutate(
    Percent_of_residual_NC_reads = 100 * NC_reads_raw / sum(NC_reads_raw),
    Exact_ASV_overlap_class = if_else(
      Exact_ASV_shared_NC_and_skin,
      "Shared exact ASV",
      "Negative-control only"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(NC_reads_raw), ASV)

residual_count_matrix <- count_matrix[residual_asv_results$ASV, , drop = FALSE]
residual_count_matrix <- residual_count_matrix[
  ,
  c(control_ids, skin_ids),
  drop = FALSE
]
colnames(residual_count_matrix) <- paste0("RawCount_", colnames(residual_count_matrix))

residual_asv_sample_counts <- residual_asv_results |>
  select(
    ASV,
    Kingdom,
    Phylum,
    Class,
    Order,
    Family,
    Genus,
    Species,
    Contaminant_at_threshold_0_5,
    Exact_ASV_overlap_class
  ) |>
  bind_cols(as.data.frame(residual_count_matrix, check.names = FALSE))

stopifnot(
  nrow(all_asv_results) == ntaxa(phy3),
  sum(all_asv_results$Contaminant_at_threshold_0_5) == 107,
  nrow(residual_asv_results) == 153,
  sum(residual_asv_results$NC_reads_raw) == 22133,
  sum(residual_asv_results$Exact_ASV_shared_NC_and_skin) == 7,
  sum(!residual_asv_results$Exact_ASV_shared_NC_and_skin) == 146,
  sum(residual_count_matrix) == 22133 + sum(residual_asv_results$Skin_reads_raw)
)

write.csv(
  all_asv_results,
  file.path(
    project_root,
    "result",
    "final",
    "tables",
    "Reviewer1_decontam_all_ASV_results.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = "",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

write.csv(
  residual_asv_results,
  file.path(
    project_root,
    "result",
    "final",
    "tables",
    "Reviewer1_residual_negative_control_ASV_results.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = "",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

write.table(
  residual_asv_sample_counts,
  file.path(
    project_root,
    "result",
    "final",
    "tables",
    "Reviewer1_residual_negative_control_ASV_sample_counts.tsv"
  ),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = "",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

tibble(
  Result = c(
    "Residual ASVs detected in negative controls",
    "Residual ASVs shared exactly with skin samples",
    "Residual ASVs detected only in negative controls",
    "Residual negative-control reads"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(residual_asv_results),
    sum(residual_asv_results$Exact_ASV_shared_NC_and_skin),
    sum(!residual_asv_results$Exact_ASV_shared_NC_and_skin),
    sum(residual_asv_results$NC_reads_raw)
  )
) |>
  kable()
```
